source: Actual approved public-entrypoint issue and lead coordination on scoped historical replay.

owner.transport: private AF_UNIX only; explicit owner startup, never client spawn
owner.identity: private bound config path/dev/inode/hash, source, scope, instance, PID/start and socket dev/inode
owner.authentication: bounded nonce HMAC request/reply; same-UID private socket/record
owner.replacement: no automatic unlink, takeover or restart

cases.oracle: Actual installed CLI run reaches real Core/runtime/resource review wait; separate installed client resumes same owner without duplicate effects.
MCP exposes exactly the same additive schemas and uses the same application operation.
Existing command schemas/intents are unchanged; no retired merge alias is introduced.
Unknown plan, raw command/file selection/passed/import fields refuse before effect.
Foreign task/session/principal or copied config cannot consume owner authority.
Stale record/socket/process/source or endpoint identity refuses; clients never launch replacement.
Concurrent clients select one serialized owner and one actual worker.
Lost initial run reply reuses original operation/task/plan and actual saved workflow after In Progress.
Changed plan/prose/runtime binding or same-key other task conflicts; replay history grants no new effect after hold/terminal.
Missing native/provider/genuine review integrations block explicitly; no authored fallback in production.
Owner restart cannot manufacture missing child handles or replay uncertain effects; old endpoint is not replaced.
Tampered/replayed/oversize/unknown JSON request or response is rejected; no credential in transcript.
Finite request/lifecycle bounds; actual owner and all children reconcile stopped; durable uncertain obligations remain.
